# personaldash.life

> personaldash.life is a free personal AI dashboard. A person copies one piece of plain text, pastes it into their AI assistant, and the assistant audits their setup, sets things up, and builds one page for their day: to-do list, email, calendar, and the people who matter to them.

The text includes the HMR written instructions for human and AI interaction, the middle layer between a person in the physical world and their AI in the digital one. It is written for people who are new to AI, including older people, and it works by voice. The person's own rules sit on top of ours, and the AI company's rules come first.

## Docs

- [Setup guide](https://personaldash.life/setup/claude-setup-guide.md): The full instructions a person pastes into a new chat on day one.
- [Dashboard instructions](https://personaldash.life/dashboard/personaldash.md): Instructions for the AI to build the person's personal dashboard after setup.
- [AGENTS.md](https://personaldash.life/setup/AGENTS.md): The written instructions in short form, for any AI assistant or agent.

## Optional

- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/AtlasJumped/personaldash.life): Source files, version history, and the place to suggest changes.
